set.title: Hekayah | The Story – Eid al Etihad Celebration
set.venue: Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial Stage, Mina Zayed
set.description: The 12th Hekayah | The Story by The Arts Center at NYU Abu Dhabi, with poets, singers, dancers and musicians from across the UAE sharing stories of home and belonging for Eid al Etihad. This year it moves from The Arts Center to the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial stage at Mina Zayed.
